hero.h1: Buy Directive 8020 | Editions, Platforms & Upgrade Requirements
hero.intro: Choose a platform first, then compare what you already own with what the package contains. Prices and offers can differ by store, region and checkout time.

blocks.text: The official store describes outfits, additional Dark Pictures collectibles, cinematic filters, a digital artbook and a soundtrack. An upgrade is not a third standalone game. Read the listing for the edition on your own platform.
